definitions.explanation: A chemical product used to whiten fabrics or remove stains.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{服|ふく}は{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}で{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: I wash white clothes with bleach.

examples.japanese: {漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}を{使|つか}いすぎると{生地|きじ}が{傷|いた}む。
examples.english: Using too much bleach will damage the fabric.

examples.japanese: {酸素系|さんそけい}{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}は{色柄物|いろがらもの}にも{使|つか}える。
examples.english: Oxygen-based bleach can be used on colored and patterned items too.

notes:
FORMATION:
{漂白|ひょうはく} (bleaching) + {剤|ざい} (agent/chemical)

TYPES:
・{塩素系|えんそけい}{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい} - chlorine bleach (stronger, for whites only)
・{酸素系|さんそけい}{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい} - oxygen bleach (gentler, color-safe)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}を{入|い}れる - to add bleach
・{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}につける - to soak in bleach
・{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}{禁止|きんし} - do not bleach (care label)

SAFETY NOTE:
Never mix chlorine bleach with ammonia or acid-based cleaners, as this produces toxic fumes.
